messages.text: PR #52 has a comment, please address.
I’ll read the comment on PR #52, make the requested revision, and run the relevant checks before pushing it.

The comment asks for an x-y barrel view including the mounting. I’ll add a full-barrel view and a close-up showing the sensor sandwich, stave and connection to the bearing ring, using the retained geometry inventory.

The figure shows both barrel layers and a mounting close-up. I chose a section that cuts through a fastener and the bearing ring, so the drawing shows their physical connection. I’m checking the labels and retained geometry hashes before adding it to PR #52.

The drawing reproduces byte-for-byte, and the section coordinates check against the retained transforms. The original geometry, reports and figures also match their recorded hashes. I’m now adding the figure to the design document and PR description.
PR #52’s branch advanced while I was preparing the drawing, so Git rejected the first push. I’ll inspect and merge the remote update, preserve its changes, then push the drawing.
The figure is now in PR #52 and its description. The remote update was the merge of PR #53’s endcap work; I preserved it in an ordinary merge. Local checks passed, and the hosted build is running.

The merged endcap files are unchanged, and tracking now records PR #53 as merged. The drawing, provenance and session log are validated. CI has passed the project checks and is still running the geometry controls.
The hosted build has passed the finite-module and early pixel checks. It is continuing through the remaining controls; there have been no reported failures.
The drawing is published and ready to inspect. CI is still running the remaining tests; I’ll close out the session log once it finishes.

CI caught a documentation dependency: the endcap tests pin the barrel design document’s exact hash, and my added caption changed it. I’ll move the figure and caption into a companion document and restore the pinned design document unchanged.

The pinned document is restored, and all eight barrel controls and ten endcap controls now pass locally. The figure and caption are preserved in the companion document. I’ll publish the correction and verify the hosted build.
The correction is pushed, and the PR description links the figure and companion caption. The session log validates in both checkouts. I’m checking the hosted build on this final revision.
The corrected head preserves every endcap input hash, and the final hosted run is underway. The figure remains available in the PR description.
The final run has passed the finite-module checks and reached the pixel controls. The corrected barrel and endcap controls have already passed locally.
CI has passed both the barrel and endcap controls. The dashboard and documentation checks are running now; the source-hash issue is resolved.

Addressed in [PR #52](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/pull/52): added an x-y barrel overview and mounting close-up, embedded in the PR description.
